run_unary_async_benchmark: run a unary async gRPC benchmark client that sends concurrent unary calls and records query times
run_streaming_async_benchmark: run a streaming async gRPC benchmark client that sends concurrent bidirectional streaming calls and records latency
create_benchmark_client_channel: create a gRPC aio channel with optional SSL credentials and custom channel arguments for benchmarking
record_query_time_histogram: record query time in nanoseconds to a histogram for latency analysis during benchmark runs
create_generic_stub: create a GenericStub that wraps a gRPC aio channel with UnaryCall and StreamingCall stubs
